body:
## Why Growing Sites Upgrade to Cloudways

Unlike shared hosting where hundreds of accounts compete for CPU cycles, **Cloudways** gives you your own dedicated cloud server on **DigitalOcean**, **AWS**, or **Google Cloud**—wrapped in an intuitive management dashboard so you never have to touch the Linux command line.

### Unthrottled NVMe & Redis Performance

Every Cloudways stack includes NGINX, Apache, Varnish, Memcached, and Redis pre-configured. On high-traffic WooCommerce and dynamic web apps, Object Cache Pro keeps database queries under 50ms even with 100 concurrent active users.

> Because Cloudways bills monthly on a pay-as-you-go basis, there are zero multi-year lock-in contracts or surprise renewal price hikes.

### Who Should Choose Cloudways?

* **Agencies & Freelancers** managing multiple client sites with isolated staging and team permissions.
* **E-Commerce Stores** that cannot afford slow checkout pages during seasonal traffic spikes.
* **Developers & SaaS Founders** who want raw cloud speed without DevOps server maintenance.
